offering_description.value: CPI Card Group sells credit, debit, and prepaid cards to financial institutions and payment companies. It manufactures and personalizes cards, packages and fulfills card orders, and provides cloud-based software that lets bank and credit union branches issue cards on site.

primary_products.value: Credit and debit cards; prepaid debit cards; instant card issuance printers and supplies

primary_services.value: Card personalization; card packaging and fulfillment; cloud-based instant card issuance

customer_segment.value: B2B: Banks, credit unions, fintech companies, payment processors, and prepaid program managers

end_markets.value: Retail banking; credit card issuing; fintech payments; prepaid payments

revenue_model.value: product sales: Manufactured payment cards, issuance printers, and printer supplies; service fees: Card personalization, packaging, and order fulfillment; transaction or usage fees: Cards issued through the instant issuance platform
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns card materials and chip modules into finished payment cards for issuers; service provider: Uses issuer data to personalize, package, and fulfill card orders for financial institutions and prepaid programs; software / platform: Connects issuer systems and branch printers so financial institutions can issue cards on site
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: US national: Financial institutions and payment companies across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Payment card manufacturing, personalization and fulfillment, and instant issuance systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Account teams serving financial institutions and prepaid program managers; partners / resellers: Payment processors and banking technology providers offering instant issuance to financial institutions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Payment card production and cardholder data handling subject to payment network and PCI security requirements
